rating.verdict: A charming theme deck. The Doctors and their companions build value, but the plan is slower and more fragile than most decks at the table. Bracket 2 (Core), no Game Changers.
strengths: Plenty of ramp and card selection
Sagas and Doctors generate steady value
Good removal and Fractured Identity for big swings
weaknesses: Few ways to actually close a game
Relies on legendary creatures that die to removal

wins: The Fourth Doctor lets you play a historic card (legendary, artifact or Saga) off the top of your library each turn. Almost the whole deck is historic, so you out-card everyone, then pump your legendary crew and attack.
plan: Mana rocks and ramp (Cultivate, Three Visits). Sarah Jane on turn 2: a Clue the first time each turn you cast a historic spell.
The Fourth Doctor. Check your top card every turn and play it from there if it’s historic (you also get a Food token).
The First Doctor fetches the TARDIS, The Eleventh Hour and The Five Doctors find more Doctors, Clara Oswald makes Doctor triggers happen twice.
Day of Destiny and Heroes’ Podium make legendary creatures huge. Twice Upon a Time takes an extra turn once you control two Doctors.
keys: Free card every turn from the top of your library.
A 1/1 Soldier for every historic spell you cast.
Copies your first historic spell each turn.
Wipes the board, then returns a legendary creature of yours.
tips: Look at the top card before you draw, so you don’t miss a free historic play.
Crack Sarah Jane’s Clues (2 mana each) at the end of an opponent’s turn.
Removal: Swords, Path, Beast Within, Trial of a Time Lord, Banish to Another Universe, Grasp of Fate.
mulligan: Keep 3–4 lands with ramp or a mana rock. The deck is slow if it misses land drops.
